task: skeptic VALUE+FEASIBILITY of R2S-3 DNVETO (night round 2)
reason: Refuted as a K3 rider in its current form. It is not a clean ship, although it is cheap to build. VALUE: (1) The prior analogue already answered the question on LB. The DivNet parent veto (I-058, probe 20) removed about 60% of forks on the dummy clips and 59 FP / 1 TP in the lab (+0.0023), yet tied at 0.947. DNVETO is the same parent-classifier mechanism at about a third of that dose, so the expected public move is below one display step and R3 can never confirm or reject it. (2) Veto break-even is q* = J/(1+J): removing an FP gains about J/D, removing a TP loses about 1/D. The finding's value uses only the public q* of 0.265. On private (71%), R2 already prices J at 0.12-0.25, so q* is 0.11-0.20, and in the lab (J 0.129) q* is 0.114. The estimated vetoed precision q = 0.25*(0.05..0.10)/0.22 = 0.06-0.11 sits at that break-even, and the TP flag rate at predicted positions is likely above the GT 5%. Private net is about +0.0007 at q 0.10, 0 at q 0.15 and -0.0004 at q 0.20. (3) The enrichment evidence is thin. The position match covers only 184/676 parents and 76/676 triples. (4) The lab tests a different function from the one that ships. The gate scores each clip with its single OOF fold, while the kernel ships the 5-fold mean, which compresses the tails, so the dose and the TP flag rate both shift in unknown directions. The 0.5x-2x dummy dose check cannot catch this: the dummy clips are train twins (4/5 folds in-sample) with 0 GT divisions. (5) Gate power is tiny. forkblob's 150 vetoes held only 7 evaluable forks, and DNVETO at ~22% dose gets about 7 too. P(TP=0) is 0.70 at q=0.05 against 0.21 at q=0.20, a likelihood ratio of about 3. With lab J 0.129 the div_J clause effectively just means 'TP == 0 by luck'. FEASIBILITY is fine but costs attention. Kernel: DIVINS_BUNDLE is a global in cell 6 and divins_frame_reader exists, so runtime is about 0, byte-identical-off and fail-soft follow the forkmid pattern, and the rider must also skip when safetail skips divins. Lab: local train zarr, weights and daughternet.score_nodes(model_index) all exist, so 10-30 min CPU. It is still an R3 rider needing the user's OK, it adds an unattributable component to the K3 bundle, and it ranks below E-items, the ANTIPAR/forkmid gates and the exp58n twin under R10. x138's DeepCenter safe-div gate (thr 0.25) scores the daughter point as a detection centre, so it is not redundant with DNVETO. That does not rescue the value.
fix: Keep DNVETO only as a cheap, pre-registered INFO/lab arm. It may ride only under all of the following. (a) Change the kernel rule so the lab bounds it. Veto only if ALL 5 fold models give p_par(P) < 0.057, i.e. max over folds < 0.057, not the mean. On unseen embryos every fold is OOS like the lab's OOF fold, so the shipped veto set is a subset of any single-fold veto set: lab harm becomes an upper bound and the dose can only shrink. Freeze this wording together with 0.057 in Addendum M before any per-fork label is read. (b) Lab arm: score the fork parents with the OOF fold model (tools/daughternet.score_nodes(model_index=fold)), and evaluate it STACKED on antipar25 (marginal after ANTIPAR), not standalone. Gate: removed evaluable TP == 0 AND removed evaluable FP >= 3 AND pooled div_J(arm) >= control AND pooled adj_edge delta >= -0.0002 AND nodes unchanged AND the R2S-5 Q3 clause. The marginal dose must be >= 5% of control forks, otherwise drop it as a no-op. Report the evaluable n; with n_eval < 5, no ship. (c) Kernel dose check: kernel-side 'max<0.057' dose on the dummies is info only (train twins, in-sample), with the hard gates nodes == K2, a fail-soft 'DNVETO FAILED' line, sha256 with DNVETO_ENABLE=0 == K2, and a skip when divins is skipped. (d) Ship only inside a K3 that already carries a passed forkmid/ANTIPAR, never as its own slot. An LB tie is the expected outcome and is not evidence. Drop it if not coded and gated by 26 Sep 12:00 UTC, or if ANTIPAR fails its own gate (same mechanism class, weaker evidence).
realistic_gain: Public +0.0000..+0.0005 (center ~+0.0002; probe-20 analogue tied at 3x the dose); private -0.0005..+0.0008 (center ~+0.0002, since the veto break-even on private is 0.11-0.20, not 0.265); P(<0 on private) ~0.35-0.4. The lab cannot resolve it (~7 evaluable vetoes on 56 clips).
